contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement opposes none of CONJ-0001, THM-0001-THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. EXACT SCOPE: FND-0066 is a purely definitional/logical statement about one degenerate case of the packet theorem for the single group G := W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) = W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21) (d=21, BM weight -16 type Q(8), ordinary degree/weight 26, untwisted type Q(-13), Chow codimension 13). TRUTH: correct. Under the standard convention that an empty direct sum is the zero object, G=0 satisfies 'G is a direct sum of Q(8)' with multiplicity zero, and G=0 has no nonzero summands at all, a fortiori no non-Tate summand. PRIMARY-SOURCE CHECK (why this is not a new finding): the convention is already explicit in the campaign's own primary corpus. SRC-0001 (Payne, arXiv:2605.20453, Section 2.4) states verbatim: 'For odd k<11, we have H^k(Mbar_{g,n})=0 for all g and n. Given this vanishing, the generalized Hodge and Tate conjectures hold vacuously in these cases.' The same survey (Section 5) records 'The prediction that H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) is pure Tate for even k<=20 is confirmed for k<=14, but the cases 16, 18, and 20 remain open,' consistent with OBS-0001 and CONJ-0001; SRC-0002 Theorem 1.5(3) ('R H^*(Mbar_{g,n}) contains H^k(Mbar_{g,n}), for even k<=14, for all g and n') matches THM-0002 with no separate vanishing caveat, i.e. vacuity is treated as automatic, not as a defect. FND-0066 therefore restates a source-verified convention, the same ground on which FND-0011 was retired, and is execution-scope/semantics commentary rather than mathematics, the ground on which FND-0012 was retired. THE IMPLIED DEFECT IS VOID: any reading on which the operational disproof clause is unfalsifiable or non-equivalent to the theorem fails against corroborated FND-0033. G is a polarizable pure Q-Hodge structure of weight -16, and polarizable pure Q-HS of fixed weight form a semisimple abelian category; the only Tate object of weight -16 is Q(8), so G is a direct sum of Q(8) if and only if G has no simple summand other than Q(8). Hence 'exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group' is exactly the negation of the packet theorem, including at G=0, where the theorem holds and no summand exists. The zero case is a consistency check on the clause, not a loophole. MISLABELLED KIND/IMPACT: recorded as kind='obstruction' against C66-FULL, but it obstructs nothing; it strictly weakens the burden on a proof route (a vanishing proof would discharge the pair). Its only actionable residue, that a counterexample must prove its non-Tate class nonzero in the exact target, is already the definition of subproblem C66-CEX-SURVIVE ('Test survival of a non-Tate candidate in the exact target') and is covered by the packet execution boundary. NOT NEW TO THE CAMPAIGN, NO MERGE TARGET: the vacuity observation is already on record inside equivalence groups top-degree-vanishing-may-settle-open-input (FND-0018: 'vacuously a direct sum of copies of Q(8)') and open-input-sits-in-vcd-degree (FND-0025: 'trivially a (empty) direct sum of Q(8)'), both retired for reasons unrelated to the convention (no applicable top-vcd vanishing theorem). No live equivalence group has this convention as its content, so there is no admissible merge target and merge_target_id is null. ANTECEDENT STATUS: whether G=0 is realized is open and is governed by corroborated FND-0035; for (6,6) the required ordinary degree 26 equals Harer's vcd(M_{6,6})=4g-4+n=26, so vanishing-above-vcd proves nothing. Live literature check found no computation of this group: arXiv:2603.26962 (Deligne weight spectral sequence and tautological cohomology) states it can in principle reach only 2g+n<=12 and reports results for genus five unmarked and (3,3), while (6,6) has 2g+n=18, far outside range; it makes no claim about degree 16 or M_{6,6}. FND-0066 supplies no evidence either way. PROVENANCE: sole reviewer engine grok with evidence_class adversarial_review, and grok is listed in excluded_engines for campaign revision 4; there is no independent corroboration, and nothing beyond the already-source-verified convention survives audit. INDEPENDENCE: this audit used no grok-worker assistance (zero of the four permitted dispatches) precisely because the finding's only originating engine is the campaign-excluded engine; all checks are the auditor's own against live primary sources. VERDICT: retire - true but definitional, already explicit in SRC-0001 Section 2.4, obstructing no approach, with its actionable residue already encoded in C66-CEX-SURVIVE and its antecedent governed by FND-0035. Retirement carries no implication that the target is nonzero, and no attempt may cite this retirement as evidence that G != 0.
